options.title: Har State Ka Number Plate Code 🚗 Telangana ne kyun badla?
options.first_line: आपकी गाड़ी की नंबर प्लेट पर पहले दो अक्षर कौन-से हैं?
options.first_frame: All of India on the relief map, every state still pale, a white number plate with a blank code drops onto the middle of the country

options.title: Telangana ki gaadiyon ka code kyun badla? 🚗 Har state ka code
options.first_line: तेलंगाना की नई गाड़ियों पर टी एस की जगह टी जी क्यों लिखा जाता है?
options.first_frame: Telangana lit bright yellow on the map with a plate reading TS on it, the letters starting to flip

options.title: MH, DL, KL… Har State Ka Code Ek Naksha Par 🚗
options.first_line: एम एच, डी एल, के एल: हर राज्य की गाड़ी का अपना कोड है।
options.first_frame: Three plates (MH, DL, KL) already standing on Maharashtra, Delhi and Kerala, the rest of India pale and waiting

why: It names a real state and a thing every viewer owns, opens a real mystery (why Telangana plates changed) without giving the answer, and the flipping TS plate reads with the sound off; A asks the viewer about themselves and C poses no question.
note: B's first line reworded by the writer for truth (24 Nov): only new registrations changed from TS to TG in 2024; old plates kept TS (Telangana Today, Siasat). Not 'overnight', not every vehicle.
